// ============================================================================

// Fancy Footwork — Passive Logic / Custom Logic - Resolution

// Trigger setup:

// Event: Whenever a creature attacks and misses

// Source Filter: Enemy

//

// Effect:

// If an enemy misses the owner of Fancy Footwork,

// and their Accuracy is at least (6 - SL) lower than the owner's Defense,

// the enemy who missed suffers Fatigue.

//

// Player-client safe:

// - If the current client can apply the AE locally, it does.

// - Otherwise, it routes ONLY the Active Effect application through GMExecutor.

// - This means players can trigger the passive without needing GM permissions.

//

// Fatigue AE UUID:

// Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.2DYDlLqoyg0JXQza

// ============================================================================

const TAG = "[PASSIVE-RES][FANCY-FOOTWORK]";

const MODULE_ID = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FATIGUE_AE_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.2DYDlLqoyg0JXQza";

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? {};

const phase =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const triggerKey =

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phase?.trigger ??

"";

function skip(reason, data = {}) {

console.debug(TAG, "SKIP:", reason, data);

return context?.skipPassive?.("", { notify: false });

}

function num(v, fallback = NaN) {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

}

function clamp(n, min, max) {

return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));

}

async function resolveDoc(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref !== "string") return ref;

try {

return await fromUuid(ref);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "fromUuid failed", { ref, err });

return null;

}

}

function actorFromDoc(doc) {

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor" || doc.constructor?.name === "Actor") return doc;

if (doc.actor) return doc.actor;

if (doc.object?.actor) return doc.object.actor;

if (doc.token?.actor) return doc.token.actor;

if (doc.parent?.actor) return doc.parent.actor;

if (doc.document?.actor) return doc.document.actor;

return null;

}

async function resolveActor(ref) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(ref);

return actorFromDoc(doc);

}

function sameActor(a, b) {

if (!a || !b) return false;

return String(a.uuid ?? "") === String(b.uuid ?? "");

}

function readDefense(actor) {

const props = actor?.system?.props ?? {};

const directKeys = ["defense", "current_def", "def"];

for (const key of directKeys) {

const n = num(props[key], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(props)) {

if (/(^|_)mod($|_)/i.test(key)) continue;

if (/(^|_)(current_)?(def|guard|armor)($|_)/i.test(key)) {

const n = num(value, NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

}

return NaN;

}

function readSkillLevel(item) {

const props = item?.system?.props ?? {};

const candidates = [

props.level,

props.skill_level,

props.current_level,

props.sl,

item?.system?.level

];

for (const value of candidates) {

const n = num(value, NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return clamp(Math.ceil(n), 1, 4);

}

return 1;

}

async function getOwnerActor() {

return (

globalThis.__PASSIVE_ACTOR ??

context?.passiveOwner ??

await resolveActor(p?.meta?.attackerActorUuid) ??

await resolveActor(p?.meta?.attackerUuid) ??

await context?.helpers?.getAttackerActor?.() ??

null

);

}

async function getPassiveItem() {

return (

globalThis.__PASSIVE_ITEM ??

context?.passiveItem ??

await resolveDoc(p?.meta?.passiveItemUuid) ??

await resolveDoc(p?.itemUuid) ??

null

);

}

async function getMissTargetActor() {

const refs = [

phase?.missTargetActorUuid,

phase?.targetActorUuid,

phase?.subjectTargetActorUuid,

phase?.targetActorUuids?.[0],

phase?.targetActorUUIDs?.[0],

phase?.targetActorUUIDs?.[0],

phase?.targetActorUUID,

phase?.targetUuid,

phase?.targetTokenUuid,

phase?.missTargetTokenUuid

];

for (const ref of refs) {

const actor = await resolveActor(ref);

if (actor) return actor;

}

return null;

}

async function getMissingCreatureActor() {

const refs = [

phase?.missSourceActorUuid,

phase?.sourceActorUuid,

phase?.attackerActorUuid,

phase?.subjectActorUuid,

phase?.actorUuid,

phase?.sourceUuid,

phase?.attackerUuid,

phase?.missSourceTokenUuid,

phase?.sourceTokenUuid,

phase?.subjectTokenUuid

];

for (const ref of refs) {

const actor = await resolveActor(ref);

if (actor) return actor;

}

return null;

}

function hasExistingFatigue(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

const fatigueId = FATIGUE_AE_UUID;

const fatigueName = "fatigue";

for (const effect of actor.effects ?? []) {

if (!effect || effect.disabled) continue;

const name = String(effect.name ?? effect.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const sourceId = String(effect.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, "sourceEffId") ?? "").trim();

const origin = String(effect.origin ?? "").trim();

if (name === fatigueName) return true;

if (sourceId === fatigueId) return true;

if (origin === fatigueId) return true;

}

return false;

}

function canCreateEffectLocally(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

if (game.user?.isGM) return true;

try {

if (actor.testUserPermission?.(game.user, CONST.DOCUMENT_OWNERSHIP_LEVELS.OWNER)) {

return true;

}

} catch (_err) {}

try {

if (actor.canUserModify?.(game.user, "update")) {

return true;

}

} catch (_err) {}

return false;

}

async function applyFatigueLocal(actor) {

if (!actor) return { ok: false, applied: false, reason: "missing_actor" };

if (hasExistingFatigue(actor)) {

return { ok: true, applied: false, alreadyHad: true, reason: "already_has_fatigue" };

}

const sourceEffect = await fromUuid(FATIGUE_AE_UUID).catch(err => {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve Fatigue Active Effect UUID.", err);

return null;

});

if (!sourceEffect) {

return { ok: false, applied: false, reason: "fatigue_effect_not_found" };

}

const effectData = foundry.utils.deepClone(sourceEffect.toObject());

// Important: remove embedded source ID so Foundry creates a fresh effect on the actor.

delete effectData._id;

effectData.disabled = false;

effectData.origin = FATIGUE_AE_UUID;

effectData.flags = effectData.flags ?? {};

effectData.flags[MODULE_ID] = {

...(effectData.flags[MODULE_ID] ?? {}),

sourceEffId: FATIGUE_AE_UUID,

appliedBy: "Fancy Footwork",

appliedAt: Date.now()

};

await actor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

return { ok: true, applied: true, reason: "applied" };

}

async function applyFatigueWithPermission({

targetActor,

ownerActor,

debug = {}

} = {}) {

if (!targetActor) {

return { ok: false, applied: false, reason: "missing_target_actor" };

}

// GM or owner of the target can do it directly.

if (canCreateEffectLocally(targetActor)) {

const localResult = await applyFatigueLocal(targetActor);

return {

...localResult,

via: "local"

};

}

// Player-safe route: ask the module GMExecutor to perform only the AE write.

const gmExecutor =

game.modules?.get(MODULE_ID)?.api?.GMExecutor ??

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.GMExecutor ??

null;

if (!gmExecutor?.executeSnippet) {

console.warn(TAG, "GMExecutor is not available. Cannot apply Fatigue from a player client.", {

target: targetActor.name,

owner: ownerActor?.name,

debug

});

ui.notifications?.warn?.("Fancy Footwork: GMExecutor is not available, so Fatigue could not be applied from this client.");

return {

ok: false,

applied: false,

reason: "gm_executor_missing",

via: "none"

};

}

const ownerActorUuid = ownerActor?.uuid ?? p?.meta?.attackerActorUuid ?? p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? null;

if (!ownerActorUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing owner actor UUID for GMExecutor validation.", {

target: targetActor.name,

debug

});

return {

ok: false,

applied: false,

reason: "missing_owner_actor_uuid_for_gm_executor",

via: "gm-executor"

};

}

const scriptText = `

const MODULE_ID = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FATIGUE_AE_UUID = globals.fatigueAeUuid;

const targetActorUuid = globals.targetActorUuid;

function hasExistingFatigue(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

const fatigueId = FATIGUE_AE_UUID;

const fatigueName = "fatigue";

for (const effect of actor.effects ?? []) {

if (!effect || effect.disabled) continue;

const name = String(effect.name ?? effect.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const sourceId = String(effect.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, "sourceEffId") ?? "").trim();

const origin = String(effect.origin ?? "").trim();

if (name === fatigueName) return true;

if (sourceId === fatigueId) return true;

if (origin === fatigueId) return true;

}

return false;

}

const targetActor = await env.resolveActor(targetActorUuid);

if (!targetActor) {

return { ok: false, applied: false, reason: "target_actor_not_found" };

}

if (hasExistingFatigue(targetActor)) {

return { ok: true, applied: false, alreadyHad: true, reason: "already_has_fatigue" };

}

const sourceEffect = await fromUuid(FATIGUE_AE_UUID).catch(() => null);

if (!sourceEffect) {

return { ok: false, applied: false, reason: "fatigue_effect_not_found" };

}

const effectData = foundry.utils.deepClone(sourceEffect.toObject());

delete effectData._id;

effectData.disabled = false;

effectData.origin = FATIGUE_AE_UUID;

effectData.flags = effectData.flags ?? {};

effectData.flags[MODULE_ID] = {

...(effectData.flags[MODULE_ID] ?? {}),

sourceEffId: FATIGUE_AE_UUID,

appliedBy: "Fancy Footwork",

appliedAt: Date.now()

};

await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

reason: "applied",

targetActorName: targetActor.name

};

`.trim();

const remote = await gmExecutor.executeSnippet({

mode: "generic",

scriptText,

payload: p,

args,

targets: [],

actorUuid: ownerActorUuid,

globals: {

targetActorUuid: targetActor.uuid,

fatigueAeUuid: FATIGUE_AE_UUID

},

metadata: {

origin: "Fancy Footwork",

debug

}

});

if (!remote?.ok) {

console.warn(TAG, "GMExecutor failed while applying Fatigue.", {

remote,

target: targetActor.name,

owner: ownerActor?.name,

debug

});

return {

ok: false,

applied: false,

reason: "gm_executor_failed",

via: "gm-executor",

error: remote?.error ?? null

};

}

return {

ok: !!remote?.resultValue?.ok,

applied: !!remote?.resultValue?.applied,

alreadyHad: !!remote?.resultValue?.alreadyHad,

reason: remote?.resultValue?.reason ?? "unknown_remote_result",

via: "gm-executor",

resultValue: remote?.resultValue ?? null

};

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Gates

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (triggerKey !== "creature_miss_action" && phase?.kind !== "miss_resolution" && phase?.result !== "miss") {

return skip("Not a miss trigger.", { triggerKey, phaseTrigger: phase?.trigger });

}

const ownerActor = await getOwnerActor();

if (!ownerActor) {

return skip("Could not resolve Fancy Footwork owner.");

}

const missedTargetActor = await getMissTargetActor();

if (!missedTargetActor) {

return skip("Could not resolve the missed target actor.", { phase });

}

// Check that the missed target is the actor who owns Fancy Footwork.

if (!sameActor(ownerActor, missedTargetActor)) {

return skip("The missed target is not the Fancy Footwork owner.", {

owner: ownerActor.name,

missedTarget: missedTargetActor.name

});

}

const missingCreatureActor = await getMissingCreatureActor();

if (!missingCreatureActor) {

return skip("Could not resolve the creature who missed.");

}

// Needs an actual Accuracy value.

const hasAccuracy = !!(

phase?.hasAccuracy === true ||

args?.hasAccuracy === true ||

p?.accuracy ||

Number.isFinite(Number(phase?.accuracyTotal)) ||

Number.isFinite(Number(args?.accuracyTotal))

);

const accTotal = num(

phase?.accuracyTotal ??

args?.accuracyTotal ??

p?.accuracy?.total,

NaN

);

if (!hasAccuracy || !Number.isFinite(accTotal)) {

return skip("No usable Accuracy total found.", {

hasAccuracy,

accTotal,

phaseAccuracy: phase?.accuracyTotal,

argsAccuracy: args?.accuracyTotal,

payloadAccuracy: p?.accuracy?.total

});

}

const passiveItem = await getPassiveItem();

const sl = readSkillLevel(passiveItem);

// Formula from the table:

// SL 1 = 5 lower, SL 2 = 4 lower, SL 3 = 3 lower, SL 4 = 2 lower.

const requiredGap = 6 - sl;

const phaseDefense = num(phase?.defenseUsed, NaN);

const ownerDefense = Number.isFinite(phaseDefense)

? phaseDefense

: readDefense(ownerActor);

if (!Number.isFinite(ownerDefense)) {

return skip("Could not read owner Defense.", {

owner: ownerActor.name,

phaseDefenseUsed: phase?.defenseUsed

});

}

const actualGap = ownerDefense - accTotal;

if (actualGap < requiredGap) {

return skip("Accuracy was not low enough.", {

owner: ownerActor.name,

missingCreature: missingCreatureActor.name,

SL: sl,

requiredGap,

defense: ownerDefense,

accuracy: accTotal,

actualGap

});

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Apply Fatigue to the enemy who missed.

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const applyResult = await applyFatigueWithPermission({

targetActor: missingCreatureActor,

ownerActor,

debug: {

owner: ownerActor.name,

missingCreature: missingCreatureActor.name,

SL: sl,

requiredGap,

defense: ownerDefense,

accuracy: accTotal,

actualGap

}

});

if (!applyResult?.applied) {

return skip("Fatigue was not applied.", {

target: missingCreatureActor.name,

result: applyResult

});

}

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED Fatigue.", {

owner: ownerActor.name,

missingCreature: missingCreatureActor.name,

SL: sl,

requiredGap,

defense: ownerDefense,

accuracy: accTotal,

actualGap,

permissionRoute: applyResult.via

});

props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Muleta - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + "Run to Front" + Return) — PSEUDO MOVE

// UPDATE:

// - Token movement is now done via ONI Pseudo Animation (everything except VFX)

// - VFX/SFX remain Sequencer (Piercing + Impact + Hit sound)

// - If CASTER disposition is NOT -1 (friendly), flip BOTH Piercing + Impact FX horizontally

// (mirrorX = true). If caster is hostile (-1), no flip.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[Muleta]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & target ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Muleta: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Muleta: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Dispositions ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const casterHostile = casterDisposition === -1;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

// Flip rule you requested:

// If caster is NOT hostile (-1) => flip FX horizontally

const mirrorX = !casterHostile;

// --- Target disposition => decides where "front" is ---

const frontIsRightOfTarget = targetHostile;

// --- Movement (Pseudo: center-based) ---

const squares = 0.65;

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const home = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

const front = {

x: targetToken.center.x + (frontIsRightOfTarget ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx),

y: targetToken.center.y,

};

const dx = front.x - home.x;

const dy = front.y - home.y;

const runMs = 280;

const walkBackMs = 480;

// Hold window (covers the Piercing VFX timeline before returning)

// If your Piercing file is longer/shorter, tune this number.

const HOLD_MS = 1000;

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillMuleta",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { casterDisposition, targetDisposition, mirrorX, frontIsRightOfTarget },

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const FX_PIERCE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Generic/Piercing_Generic01_01_Regular_Orange_1000x400.webm";

const FX_IMPACT =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_09_Regular_Orange_400x400.webm";

const SFX_HIT =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/HitSlashS.ogg";

// --- PSEUDO MOVE (run to front -> hold -> return) ---

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Muleta pseudo: missing casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// hide real token locally

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const start = { x: sprite.x, y: sprite.y };

const out = { x: start.x + Number(params.dx ?? 0), y: start.y + Number(params.dy ?? 0) };

const outMs = Number(params.outMs ?? 280);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const backMs = Number(params.backMs ?? 480);

// move out

await animateXY(sprite, start, out, outMs);

// hold while Sequencer VFX plays

await wait(holdMs);

// return

await animateXY(sprite, out, start, backMs);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

// Descabello - Custom Logic Action

// Adds:

// 1) Half caster level as bonus damage, rounded up.

// 2) Skill Enhancement bonus based on caster level:

// Lv. 20+ = base damage becomes 40, so add +10.

// Lv. 40+ = base damage becomes 50, so add +20.

//

// IMPORTANT:

// Keep the skill's normal Damage Bonus field at 30 on the sheet.

// This script adds the enhancement difference as bonus damage.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DESCABELLO]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Resolve caster / attacker

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

"";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID.", { payload: p });

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const props = attackerActor.system?.props ?? {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) Read caster level

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Tries several possible level keys, so this is safer if your sheet name changes.

const levelCandidates = [

props.level,

props.current_level,

props.character_level,

props.lv,

props.Level

];

let casterLevel = 0;

for (const raw of levelCandidates) {

const n = Number(raw);

if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) {

casterLevel = n;

break;

}

}

if (!casterLevel) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not detect caster level. No bonus applied.", {

actor: attackerActor.name,

checkedKeys: ["level", "current_level", "character_level", "lv", "Level"]

});

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Calculate bonus damage

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const halfLevelBonus = Math.ceil(casterLevel / 2);

let enhancementBonus = 0;

let enhancementTier = "None";

if (casterLevel >= 40) {

enhancementBonus = 20; // 30 -> 50

enhancementTier = "Lv. 40 Enhancement";

} else if (casterLevel >= 20) {

enhancementBonus = 10; // 30 -> 40

enhancementTier = "Lv. 20 Enhancement";

}

const totalBonus = halfLevelBonus + enhancementBonus;

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 4) Apply to advPayload.bonus

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + totalBonus;

// Optional debug info saved into payload meta.

p.meta.descabello = {

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "Applied Descabello bonus damage.", {

caster: attackerActor.name,

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();

props.classMechanic_text:
MATADOR MECHANIC — ADORATION

“All eyes on me—step in, miss, and hear the crowd roar.”

What Is Adoration?

Adoration is your hype meter. You build it when enemies swing at you and miss, then cash it in for dramatic Passes—signature moves that control, punish, or finish the fight.

  • Adoration Clock: A 5-section track created when you learn Passes. Fill 1 section whenever an enemy attacks you and misses.
  • Resets: The clock resets to empty when an enemy successfully deals damage to you with an Attack/Skill/Spell, and at the end of each scene.
  • Spending: Your Passes list each have an Adoration cost. When you use one, empty that many sections.

How to Build Adoration (Bait the Miss)

Ole (Active)

As an action, pick a visible foe—they make a Free Attack against you (you must not be wearing martial armor). You take a temporary –[SL×2] Defense for that attack. If they miss, you gain [SL] Adoration.

Encore Performance (Passive)

Once per turn when a creature targets you with an attack and misses, you can make them attack you again (Free Attack). Another chance to miss → another Clock fill.

Grace Under Pressure (Passive)

While in Crisis, you gain +[SL] Defense. Higher Defense = more misses = more Adoration.

Fancy Footwork (Passive)

When an enemy attacks you and misses by at least [SL+1] vs your Defense, they also suffer Fatigue. You punish whiffs while fueling your meter.

Golden Rule: You only gain Adoration from misses against you. Guarding can still be fine, but the Matador shines by not being hit and then spending big.

How to Spend — Passes (Signature Moves)

PassAdoration CostTargetWhat it does (short)
Capote4One creatureTaunt/control—choose to inflict Provoked or Berserk.
Castigo3One creatureWeaken them with Bane.
Corrida Finale5One BeastCompel a soldier-rank Beast to attack nearby enemies this turn.
Descabello5One creatureCrush finisher. Deal big Physical damage: base 30 + half your level (40 at Lv20, 50 at Lv40).
Faena4One creatureFree Attack with a melee weapon 3 times (no HR in damage), same target.
Festivities5All alliesRally the crowd—all allies gain Swift.
Muleta1One creatureQuick jab: deal [HR+10] Physical; 50% to inflict Bleed. (Scales at Lv20/Lv40.)
Tafallera3All enemiesOverflow sweep: deal [HR+10] Physical to each enemy (higher base at Lv20/Lv40).
Triumphal Salute5Self (Reaction)When targeted by an Attack/Skill/Spell, raise your Defense by +2 for that action.
Verónica2SelfClassic flourish (table variant): often a stance/positioning buff—use the one on your sheet.

Turn Loop — Step by Step

  1. Invite the swing: Move into threat, or use Ole to force a Free Attack. If they miss → fill 1 section (or more if your Ole grants [SL] directly).
  2. Encore? If they already missed, trigger Encore Performance once per turn to let them try (and miss) again.
  3. Spend or bank: With enough sections, fire a Pass (e.g., Faena for burst, Festivities for team tempo, Capote for control). If danger is high, keep banking for Triumphal Salute clutch defense.
  4. Protect the meter: Don’t get hit—your Clock resets when you take damage. Prioritize positioning, cover, and team buffs.

Pro tip: You’re not a tank—you’re a duelist lure. Force single-target swings and deny enemy advantage sources (Blind, Bane on you, etc.).

Worked Examples

Example A — Build-and-Burst: Turn 1, you use Ole (SL 2): foe swings with your –4 Defense penalty and misses → gain 2 Adoration. They miss again due to Encore Performance → Clock fills another section (now 3). Turn 2, you bait one more miss (4) then spend on Faena (4) for a triple strike on the boss.

Example B — Crowd Control Pivot: You bank to 5, then a summon wave appears. Spend Tafallera (3) to sweep the adds, keep 2 banked. Next turn, use Capote (4) after a fresh miss to force the elite to focus you (Provoked) so your allies can free-cast.

Build & Play Tips

  • Accuracy/Defense first: Dex/Insight and gear that raise Defense make misses happen. Crisis builds love Grace Under Pressure.
  • Positioning > Soaking: Cover, high ground, and “single-lane” duels reduce incoming fire and protect your Clock.
  • Team hooks: Allies that impose Bane, reduce Accuracy, or peel threats make it easier to bait misses.
  • Pass loadout: Carry one of each role—Faena/Descabello (burst), Capote (control), Festivities (tempo), Tafallera (AOE), Triumphal Salute (safety).

Pocket Card (Hand to Players)

  1. Clock: 5 sections. +1 on each miss against you. Reset when you take damage or scene ends.
  2. Build: Ole to force swings, Encore to try again, Grace to boost Defense in Crisis.
  3. Spend: Use Passes by paying the listed Adoration cost (empty that many sections).
  4. Protect the meter: Don’t get hit— cover, reactions. Spend for Triumphal Salute if needed.
  5. Plan the turn: Bait → Fill → Pass (burst/control/tempo) → reposition.

Matadors are theatrical duelists who turn every battle into a measured dance. Cloaked in poise and precision, they lure foes into overextending, slip past danger with a half step, and answer with needle-point strikes. Years of training in tempo, footwork, and reading intent make them master controllers of pace—experts at opening defenses with feints and punishing mistakes with ruthless efficiency.

Though they lack the heavy protection of knights or the arcane force of sorcerers, Matadors safeguard their allies by commanding attention, redirecting charges, and isolating the most dangerous opponent for a decisive duel. They shine against powerful single targets and in chaotic melees alike, threading through conflict to create windows for the party. Many mistake their bravado for vanity; those who fight beside one know it for what it is: unshakable discipline, a calm heart held inches from the fatal line.
